title: Radiance Inviolate
author: DemonApologist
description:
Radiance Inviolate is an interactive dark fantasy novelette about Lysander, a starving vampire snared in a deadly trap. He has what remains of the night to find a way out, or face death once more at dawn.

About 6k words per readthrough, with 14k words total of narrative to explore. There are six standard endings, but seven official endings.

CW: Blood, confinement, death, hunting, and violence. More details available in the “Content notes” menu.
